disease.diseaseId: Muscular dystrophy, congenital, with rapid progression
disease.description: An autosomal recessive congenital disease that manifests with severely progressive muscular dystrophy, and results in death in infancy or early childhood. Clinical features include hypotonia and poor feeding, delayed motor development, progressive weakness and lethargy, and respiratory insufficiency. Some patients may have refractory epilepsy and cataracts.
